record.question: Who won Jnanpith Award on 3rd November 2017?
record.explanation: Answer B: Krishna Sobti. Krishna Sobti was the 2017 Jnanpith laureate. The awarding organization’s own list identifies year, writer and Hindi language. The 3 November date refers to the award announcement, not necessarily its presentation ceremony. Historical/source note: 2017 award selection/announcement; do not equate announcement and later ceremonial presentation. Reference: https://www.jnanpith.net/laureates.html?id=3. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
